items.t: Vodafone’s Turnaround Is Working Everywhere Except Germany
items.sum: Vodafone raised its profit and cash-flow outlook after strong business and African growth, but a €4.85 billion writedown and thousands more job cuts show that Europe’s biggest telecom turnaround still has one stubborn problem.
